results.name: Earthquake in Guatemala
results.reason: On 8 July 2025 at 21:41 UTC, a series of earthquakes have affected a portion 20 km away from the City of Guatemala, involving 3 million people. The highest one was 5,6 degrees. The event has caused several incidents like mass movements, landslides, damage to infrastructures and road obstructions. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide reference, initial rough estimation, event extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.
results.activator: EU Services|EEAS (EU Intelligence Analysis Centre), Delegations of the European Union
